note: Aggregated preferences and engagement patterns from earlier campaigns. Insights are hypotheses and are bias-reviewed before the planner may use them.

family.summary: Co-viewing households; respond to multi-generational warmth and gentle mystery.

insights.claim: Multi-generational warmth drives completion for family promos.
A light mystery beat lifts click-through.

young_adult.summary: Mobile-first viewers; respond to pace, humour and character friction.

insights.claim: Twist-teaser promos had the highest share rate.
Humour combined with family rivalry lifts completion.

dialect_region.summary: Viewers in the eastern regional market watching with dialect subtitles.

insights.claim: Comedic dialect clips got 2.3x engagement in this region.
insights.provenance: 81% of promos previously shown in this region were comedy cuts; sample drawn from one district.

insights.claim: Viewers in lower-income districts prefer slapstick.
Authentic language and family themes drive completion (balanced survey).
